claim: negative controls; each must fail the check it targets

controls.control: NC-A generic substitute (pass-through + fixed gain occupant in bins2)

legs.detail: the generic pass-through+gain substitute must not reproduce the declared occupant's output bit-exactly
the substitute keeps no per-instance TDF2 history, so the dual-instance checkpoint must differ

controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (generic substitute FAILS bit-exact reproduction of the declared per-instance occupant; labeled ADAPTED and refused from original-preset coverage)

controls.control: NC-B dropped tail (render truncated to 2/8 declared blocks)

legs.detail: a truncation control proves nothing unless the dropped region actually contains nonzero tail samples
the truncated render must fail the declared-tail-span coverage check
the truncated render's final per-instance state must not match the full render's

controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (truncated render FAILS the declared-tail-span coverage and checkpoint checks, and the dropped region demonstrably contained real audio)

legs.detail: permuting the two slot occupants must change the bus output when the chain saturates in between

two LTI biquads in series COMMUTE in exact arithmetic, so a linear-pair permutation is detectable only through fixed-point rounding -- integer-exact equality still flags it, and the bound is recorded rather than hidden
rf_bins12_mutants.sv -DNC_SWAP_ORDER evaluates bins2 before bins1; it must FAIL exact equality against the frozen model

controls.targets: order-sensitive equality of the series insert chain
controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (the order-sensitive check flags the permutation; the linear-commutation bound is recorded)

controls.control: NC-D shared state (both insert slots pooled into one history)

legs.detail: pooling both instances' histories must diverge from the correctly-isolated bus on the SAME per-block inputs
the pooled mutant cannot reproduce two independent checkpoint halves
rf_bins12_mutants.sv -DNC_SHARED_STATE pools both slots onto one register set; it must FAIL exact equality (output AND per-instance checkpoint) against the frozen model

controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (pooled-state mutants FAIL the dual-instance-independence check, model-side and in live RTL)

legs.detail: revision_pin_ok() must reject a stale pin and accept the live one
the comparator invoked with a stale pin must exit nonzero with status REFUSED instead of reporting PASS

controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (a stale pin is REFUSED -- the comparator cannot report PASS)
